title: Before you head out
points: Stay on public paths, pavements and parks. Never enter private property.
Missions never need you near traffic. Keep away from roads and railways.
Look at water from where it is safe. Never step in.
Keep your feet on the ground. No climbing.
Look, don't touch. Never pick, eat or handle wild plants or animals.
You never need to approach or talk to strangers.
Go out in daylight, or with someone you trust.
Phone in your pocket, eyes on the world. Stop the story any time.
